## For vehicle profile or threshold changes

Sensor physics changes require empirical justification. Please include:

- [ ] Field test data (raw sensor traces, or statistics from real drives)
- [ ] Reference to peer-reviewed literature on vehicle dynamics (if applicable)
- [ ] Target vehicle / road type and country / region

## For new platform ports (iOS, Flutter, etc.)

- [ ] Describe the platform's sensor APIs and any differences from Android
- [ ] Confirm you are willing to own long-term maintenance of the port
